tools.name: overview
tools.description: Get a concise professional profile and the available case studies, essays and blog topics. Start here to explore research leadership, building products from an idea to release, and practical AI experiments.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Read Aleksei’s public CV, roles, education and selected strengths, with links to supporting projects and sources. Returns the same approved facts as the human-readable CV.

tools.name: find_evidence_for_role
tools.description: Match a role, a hiring brief or a whole job description against Aleksei’s published work. Returns his most relevant experience first, with his recorded contribution, exact excerpts and source links. Paste the vacancy text as is. Keyword retrieval: no invented qualifications and no suitability score.

tools.name: search_content
tools.description: Search Aleksei’s published project stories and blog. Find how a tool was built, what happened at release, a team result or a curious experiment, then read its complete Markdown.

tools.name: read_content
tools.description: Read one published entry as copyable Markdown with its dates, contribution, translation status and source links. Use the returned source text for factual claims.

tools.name: related_content
tools.description: Find posts connected by explicit editorial links or shared tags. Each result states the connection; this does not infer a professional achievement.
